name: TejashwiniSaravanan/Spotify-Big-Data-Analysis-Spark

name: TejashwiniSaravanan/global-affordability-dashboard-tableau-ml
description: End-to-end ML and Tableau project analyzing urban affordability across 3,700+ cities and 195+ countries. Identifies 127 Crisis Zone countries where living costs exceed local earnings.
